title: 第107章：要我下跪，不可能！
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“要我下跪，不可能！”

大力冷哼一声，将头别向一边。

秦昭岚刚放下的手，又缓缓抬了起来。

见样，大力脸色一变。

不等秦昭岚开口，他“扑通”一声，面对着秦昭岚跪了下来。

“我错了，求你饶了我！”

“不是不下跪吗？怎么秦夫人还没开口，他就跪下了？”

“可能是腿骨不如嘴硬，被秦夫人吓软了吧！”

众人看向大力，丝毫不掩饰眸中的嘲笑。

士兵们面面相觑，觉得非常没有面子。

他们可是兵，大力居然给这些囚犯和山匪下跪，真是丢脸！

“你们呢，跪还是不跪？”

秦昭岚的声音，缓缓传入耳里。

刚才还觉得没面子的士兵，顿时双膝一曲，纷纷跪了下来。

“我们错了，我们再也不敢了。”

“我们给你们送物资，被暴雪困了两天。我们也是太累了，才会霸占你们的房间休息。”

“是啊是啊，看在我们也是为了给你们送物资的份上，饶了我们这一次吧！”

士兵们看向秦昭岚，希望她不要“恩将仇报”。

秦昭岚闻言，冷笑一声。

“你们的确给我们送来了物资，但这是萧将军派给你们的任务。别想拿你们的任务，要求我们对你们感恩戴德。”

苏安安点了点小脑袋，奶声奶气地补充道：“这叫道德绑架！”

秦昭岚秀眉一挑，觉得这个词倒是挺新鲜，默默记在了心里。

她看向跪了一地的士兵，将手枪收了起来。

“滚吧！”

“好好好，我们这就滚！”

大力应了一声，连滚带爬地逃走。

刘大勇看着他们离开的背影，不安地蹙起眉头。

“秦夫人，咱们就这样放走他们，不怕他们回去告状吗？”

“让他们告吧！”秦昭岚不以为意，“他们若是死在这里，会更麻烦。”

秦昭岚轻易不想杀人。

特别是这些人，还是保家卫国的士兵。

只要他们不过分，他们可以相安无事。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"It's impossible for me to kneel down!"

Dali snorted coldly and turned his head to one side.

Qin Zhaolan's hand that he just put down slowly raised it again.

Seeing this, Dali's expression changed.

Before Qin Zhaolan could speak, he made a "plop" and knelt down facing Qin Zhaolan.

"I was wrong, please forgive me!"

"Don't you want to kneel down? Why did he kneel down before Mrs. Qin opened her mouth?"

"Maybe it's because the bones in the legs are not as strong as the words, and I was frightened by Mrs. Qin!"

Everyone looked at Dali without hiding the ridicule in their eyes.

The soldiers looked at each other and felt very humiliated.

They are soldiers, and it is really embarrassing for Dali to kneel down to these prisoners and bandits!

"What about you, kneeling or not?"

Qin Zhaolan's voice slowly reached his ears.

The soldiers who felt so shameless just now suddenly bent their knees and knelt down one after another.

"We were wrong and we never dare again."

"We were delivering supplies to you, but we were trapped by the blizzard for two days. We were too tired, so we occupied your room to rest."

"Yes, yes, for the sake of delivering supplies to you, please spare us this time!"

The soldiers looked at Qin Zhaolan, hoping that she would not "repay kindness with hatred."

Qin Zhaolan sneered when he heard this.

"You did send us supplies, but this is a mission assigned to you by General Xiao. Don't try to use your mission to ask us to be grateful to you."

Su Anan nodded her little head and added in a sweet voice: "This is called moral kidnapping!"

Qin Zhaolan raised her eyebrows, feeling that this word was quite fresh, and silently kept it in mind.

She looked at the soldiers kneeling on the ground and put away the pistol.

"Go away!"

"Okay, okay, let's get out of here!"

Da Dali responded, rolling and crawling away.

Liu Dayong looked at their leaving figures and frowned uneasily.

"Mrs. Qin, if we let them go like this, aren't we afraid that they will go back and complain?"

"Let them sue!" Qin Zhaolan said unconcernedly, "If they die here, it will be even more troublesome."

Qin Zhaolan doesn't want to kill anyone easily.

Especially these people are soldiers who protect their homes and countries.

As long as they don't go overboard, they can live in peace.
